scope: GetFileAttributesA/W in the existing mounted ASCII namespace. Regular-file and directory attributes use the same declared Apple-backed profile as FindFirstFileA; this is not a complete NTFS attribute store.
behavior: Bounded ASCII A and UTF16 W names are copied through instrumented loads; non-ASCII remains ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED.
The final component is resolved without following a link. lstat reads real metadata without opening file contents or entering the file-share registry.
Directories return DIRECTORY; regular files return ARCHIVE, matching the mounted search profile. Missing owner-write mode adds READONLY; UF_HIDDEN adds HIDDEN.
Success preserves LastError. Missing leaf returns FILE_NOT_FOUND; missing or non-directory parent returns PATH_NOT_FOUND. Invalid/long names and namespace escapes retain explicit errors.
Final symlinks and special objects return ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED; Windows reparse attributes are not guessed from a target.
The original absent certificate filename is not created or replaced by a test asset.
tests: Actual A/W stdcall wrappers preserve all CPU bytes except EAX and argument cleanup; inputs remain unchanged.

Case-insensitive file/directory queries, real chmod and hidden-flag changes, querying while a handle denies sharing, missing and malformed paths, bounds/non-ASCII rejection, symlink/special object and intermediate escape handling.
Mac normal/TSan/both guards and sole guarded iPad; three rejected protected name reads (A, W, cross-page UTF16).
Existing filesystem/file/search/environment normal/TSan and emitted CreateFile SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES/metadata regressions.
limits: No full Windows ACL/security/NTFS archive-state or other extended-attribute parity.
No final native symbolic-link attribute mapping until a retained Windows link kind is available.
Successful guarded ReadFile still needs its separate host-buffer implementation.
